title: Feminism on the roads
author: Aziliz Podcast
description: Feminism on the roads is a monthly podcast that will make you discover Icelandic feminism. Going all over this tiny island to give a voice to as many women as possible. Seeing how a country such as iceland as become the most equal country in the world and what does that mean on an everyday bases in women's and men's lives. Sur les routes du féminisme est un podcast mensuel qui vous fera découvrir le féminisme Islandais. War hentoù ar gwregelouriezh a zo ur podcast a lako ac'hanoc'h da ziozoleiñ ar gwregelouriezh e Bro ar skorn. Podcast by Aziliz Podcast Logo : Lucie Bouchet Hébergé par Ausha.
